note: Iteration 5: QEMU 11.1.3 (our source build) cut fresh writes to 0.15-0.2x of distro 8.2.2 with multi-second stalls, and still hung on virtio-mmio with event_idx on. This iteration separates build from version (8.2.2 built from source the same way, Ubuntu's prebuilt 10.2.1 and 11.0.3, source 9.2.4 and 10.2.4), and adds dm-thin: each VM disk is an LVM thin snapshot of a base volume, used as a raw block device (64K chunks, zeroing on).
rerun_note: Second run of iteration 6: the configs whose setup failed in the first run (dm-thin on local, Ubuntu 26.10), plus QEMU 10.0.6 and 10.1.5 to find which release brought the fresh-write regression (9.2.4 is fine, 10.2.x is not). The baseline only runs paired.

configs.why: dm-thin with today's prod cache settings (sandbox-safe)
